views.name: paper_authors
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  a.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName,
  p.title AS title,
  p.year AS year,
  p.venueId AS venueId,
  p.journalId AS journalId
FROM writes w
JOIN paper p ON w.paperId = p.paperId
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
views.description: One row per paper-author association, joining paper and author identity for easy filtering and joins. Exposes paper ids, author ids, and author names along with basic paper metadata (title, year, venue, journal) for downstream queries.

views.name: paper_keyphrases_datasets
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  kp.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId,
  k.keyphraseName AS keyphraseName,
  pd.datasetId AS datasetId,
  d.datasetName AS datasetName
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN paperKeyphrase kp ON p.paperId = kp.paperId
LEFT JOIN keyphrase k ON kp.keyphraseId = k.keyphraseId
LEFT JOIN paperDataset pd ON p.paperId = pd.paperId
LEFT JOIN dataset d ON pd.datasetId = d.datasetId
WHERE kp.keyphraseId IS NOT NULL OR pd.datasetId IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per paper-keyphrase and paper-dataset association (denormalized view for topic/dataset filtering). Useful for filtering papers by keyphrase or dataset and for joins with paper metadata.

views.name: paper_citation_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId,
  p.title,
  p.year,
  p.numCiting,
  p.numCitedBy,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cite c WHERE c.citedPaperId = p.paperId
  ), 0) AS computed_incoming_citations
FROM paper p
views.description: Paper-level aggregated citation metrics and basic metadata. Exposes per-paper citation counts and existing stored citation fields for filtering and ranking.

views.name: paper_basic_metadata
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.title AS title,
  p.year AS year,
  p.venueId AS venueId,
  p.journalId AS journalId,
  -- normalize nulls to 0 for citation counts
  COALESCE(pc.numCitedBy, 0) AS numCitedBy,
  COALESCE(pc.numCiting, 0) AS numCiting
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN paper_citation_counts pc ON pc.paperId = p.paperId
views.description: One row per paper with canonical core metadata: publication year, venue and journal references, and raw citation counts. Normalizes nulls and exposes the primary keys needed to join to authors, venues, journals, datasets, and keyphrases.

views.name: paper_coauthors_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COUNT(DISTINCT w.authorId) AS author_count,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.authorName, ', ')
     FROM writes w2
     JOIN author a ON a.authorId = w2.authorId
     WHERE w2.paperId = p.paperId
     ORDER BY a.authorName
    ),
    ''
  ) AS author_names_concat
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN writes w ON w.paperId = p.paperId
GROUP BY p.paperId
views.description: Aggregated per-paper author list and author count: concatenated/coalesced author names and count of distinct authors. Useful for quickly filtering papers by presence of specific co-authors or by author team size.

views.name: author_coauthorship_pairs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  CASE WHEN a1.authorId < a2.authorId THEN a1.authorId ELSE a2.authorId END AS authorA_id,
  CASE WHEN a1.authorId < a2.authorId THEN a2.authorId ELSE a1.authorId END AS authorB_id
FROM paper AS p
JOIN writes AS w1 ON p.paperId = w1.paperId
JOIN writes AS w2 ON p.paperId = w2.paperId
JOIN author AS a1 ON w1.authorId = a1.authorId
JOIN author AS a2 ON w2.authorId = a2.authorId
WHERE a1.authorId <> a2.authorId
views.description: Pairwise co-authorship edges: one row per unordered author-author pair per paper, with the paper that connects them. Useful to compute collaboration networks and check whether two authors have co-authored a paper (and which papers).

views.name: paper_citation_category
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COALESCE(p.numCitedBy, 0) AS numCitedBy,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCitedBy, 0) = 0 THEN 'uncited'
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCitedBy, 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'low'
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCitedBy, 0) BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'high'
  END AS citation_category
FROM paper p
views.description: Classifies each paper into a citation category based on raw numCitedBy. Keeps original numCitedBy and provides a categorical label; treat NULL as 0 when classifying.
